scope: Checked source-session/export-definition identity bridge and graph construction; no borrowed parameter permission, final State/Frame effect authority, new native service execution, or guest execution admission.

api.constructor: front.session(projectRoot, moduleBatch, target, include?) delegates to nativeunit.session; all real source files staged first
api.seal: One private incremental project, no exposed import/update/overlay API. Checked source bytes and absence records cover module dependencies, declaration-index sources, external inputs, and configuration. Source validation brackets graph construction.
api.identity: Exact checked imported member definition to selected body declaration; module-variable aliases retain this identity. Arbitrary value aliases and synthetic export-key aliases refuse.
api.target: One genuine nativephysical context per sealed unit, supplied only through private issued options; physical.same remains unchanged.
api.options: Exact original plain option map; added helperModules/program fields, copied options, foreign owners and metatable hooks refuse.

preconditions: Owner CST and checked type objects are immutable borrowed compiler data; this does not authenticate arbitrary deep in-place syntax/type corruption.
Public module/owner records and scalar constant maps/token inputs are checked for the mutations covered by this component.
A caller-chosen module name/path is not canonical runtime-service authority; future final-frame binding needs a closed trusted core producer.
Typed pointer and borrow metadata are retained exactly; unchanged borrowed heap helpers remain unadmitted.
compatibility: Old front.checked retains its checking environment and extraction behavior. Owner/constants extraction moved mechanically to the shared utility. Default profiles retain their prior resolution; non-session native initialization and intrinsic fallback remain unchanged.

tools.preparation: Canonical test runner built its fresh worker and private test executable; no installed compiler generation mutation.

firstRed.kind: check-driver package-selection error, not product-source failure
firstRed.detail: Root manifest assigned native.core.src.nupp.core.source to the core source path, causing NUPP1002 and internal-namespace diagnostics. Corrected only the driver to check that file in a staged package with explicit src/core include roots; no root manifest or product source change.
